supplemental_atom.scope: bounded supplemental official arXiv retrieval, not substantive review or source exhaustiveness

time_filter_utc.basis: Atom entry published is original submission; announcement listing dates are not used for this time filter.

query.search_query: (cat:cs.AI OR cat:cs.CL OR cat:cs.CV OR cat:cs.IR OR cat:cs.LG OR cat:cs.RO OR cat:cs.SE OR cat:stat.ML) AND submittedDate:[202611091023 TO 202611091600]

limitations: The API snapshot is limited to records indexed when queried. A later announcement or index correction may reveal another November 9 submission.
No inference about institutional affiliation, scope, full text, production A/B, reproducibility or cost. Candidate-level and institution-source review is separate.
Official announcements are date-based; a November 10 listing may include pre-cutoff and next-day Shanghai submissions. No watermark advance is authorized by retrieval alone.

nonterminal_primary_checks.title: ECOS: Environment-Calibrated On-Policy Self-Distillation for Language Agents
nonterminal_primary_checks.observation: 以环境命令优势校准策略内自蒸馏并给反思/技能打分。原文使用 3B、7B 骨干，在 ALFWorld、WebShop 采集轨迹并由 GPT-6.1 sol 提供离线标注，之后进行 150 次在线更新。没有可直接引用的 GPU 总量或墙钟预算；命令优势调制可以与整套训练分开评估。

nonterminal_primary_checks.title: SciMARS: Multi-Agent Recursive Self-Improvement for Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery
nonterminal_primary_checks.observation: 用共享证据图分别修订角色、协作及记忆策略。完整 Autonomous Science Bench 比较依赖 GPT-6-Astra 和 GLM-5.3 两个模型组，每组 90 次尝试；另有 ScienceAgentBench 和 AppWorld。精确复刻依赖多轮外部调用；需另核对公开代码与可低成本隔离的组件，未把候选关闭。
